title: The scaffold ships node-pg-migrate and the generated app migrates green
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-8f86e10504c74e248ccfa6f427b41a15 (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-05). Dependency-free LEAF.

ARCHITECT DECISION on the question the parent left open ("architect picks drizzle-kit or node-pg-migrate; pinned"): NODE-PG-MIGRATE. Reasons, so it is not re-litigated: (1) drizzle-kit implies adopting DRIZZLE ORM as the generated product's data layer - a far larger commitment that constrains how every future node writes schema and query code, for a row whose subject is only migrations; (2) this feature needs first-class REVERT (`db:migrate:down`, and `deployment.migrate_down` reverting the last batch), and node-pg-migrate has an explicit up/down per migration while SQL-diff generators handle down poorly; (3) plain migration files are easier for a CODING SEAT to author correctly than a schema file plus generated diffs, and seats are who will write them; (4) it is PostgreSQL-specific, which matches the controlled profile exactly. PIN THE VERSION.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the scaffold profile's migration surface - the pinned tool, `pnpm db:migrate` and `pnpm db:migrate:down` scripts, a `migrations/` directory with an initial migration - and the proof that the generated app actually migrates against a real disposable PostgreSQL. No verifier leg, no deploy, no UI.

COORDINATION, NOT A DEPENDENCY: the scaffold generator belongs to task-4a0f706437a042059789be2ebdb98bc0 (under the repository-bootstrapping parent), whose golden test pins the generated tree under a PROFILE VERSION constant. This row CHANGES that tree, so it is a profile version BUMP, not an edit in place, and that row's golden test moves with it. Check which of the two landed first and coordinate - do not fork a second scaffold.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04): no migration tooling anywhere. `grep -rn 'db:migrate|MIGRATION_' --include=*.ts apps/ packages/` finds only unrelated scheduler fairness constants (fairness-cap-revision.ts:53, fairness-aging.ts:110). The gap is real.
definitionOfDone: The scaffold profile ships node-pg-migrate at a PINNED version, with `pnpm db:migrate` and `pnpm db:migrate:down` scripts and a `migrations/` directory containing an initial migration. The scaffold golden test (task-4a0f7064's) is updated as a PROFILE VERSION BUMP rather than an edit in place, so a product's starting tree stays identifiable by its version.

THE GENERATED APP ACTUALLY MIGRATES: a test starts a disposable PostgreSQL, runs the generated app's `pnpm db:migrate` against it, and asserts the schema exists afterwards (assert a table from the initial migration is present, not merely that the command exited 0 - a migration tool with nothing to do also exits 0). Quote the CHILD run's output, labelled as the generated product's, never conflated with moe-next's own gates.

`pnpm db:migrate:down` REVERTS it: run down and assert the table is gone. This is the arm that makes `deployment.migrate_down` possible later, and the reason node-pg-migrate was chosen over a diff generator - if down does not work cleanly here, say so now rather than after the deploy path depends on it.

MIGRATION_TOOL_MISSING is defined with its layer for a workspace that declares no `db:migrate` script (the code is raised by children 2 and 3 - define it here and say where it is exercised rather than manufacturing a call site).

Determinism holds: the migration filenames and the initial migration's bytes are stable across two generations, since node-pg-migrate names files by timestamp by default and a timestamped filename would break the scaffold golden test. State how you pinned it.
Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
taskRails: NODE-PG-MIGRATE, PINNED. The decision and its reasons are in the description; do not substitute drizzle-kit, and do not pull in an ORM - this row adds migrations, not a data layer.
A CHANGE TO THE SCAFFOLD IS A PROFILE VERSION BUMP, coordinated with task-4a0f706437a042059789be2ebdb98bc0's golden test. Never fork a second scaffold generator.
TIMESTAMPED MIGRATION FILENAMES BREAK DETERMINISM. node-pg-migrate names by timestamp by default and the scaffold golden test requires byte-identical trees - pin it and say how.
PROVE UP AND DOWN AGAINST A REAL POSTGRES. `exit 0` is not proof: a tool with nothing to do also exits 0.
NO VERIFIER LEG, NO DEPLOY, NO UI: those are children 2 and 3.
